head_commit.message:
[codex] Avoid forced directory refresh during plugin install auth checks (#25381)

## Summary
- Use normal directory loading for plugin install app metadata so
install avoids forced directory refresh while still loading metadata on
cold cache.
- Continue force-refreshing codex_apps tools for auth state.
- Add regression coverage that pre-warms the directory cache and asserts
install returns cached app metadata without extra directory requests.

## Validation
- just fmt
- git diff --check
- just test -p codex-app-server plugin_install_returns_apps_needing_auth
plugin_install_filters_disallowed_apps_needing_auth (blocked locally:
cargo-nextest is not installed)

workflow_runs.display_title: Compose requirements layers

head_commit.message:
Use primary source for composed hook requirements

When managed hooks come from a composed requirements field, map the hook source through the first contributing requirements source instead of treating every composite as cloud requirements.

This keeps hook source attribution coarse but honest: requirements composition preserves source order by priority, while hook discovery still only carries one source for the merged hooks field rather than exact per-hook provenance.

workflow_runs.name: sdk
workflow_runs.display_title: Move cloud requirements crate to cloud config

head_commit.message:
Refactor cloud config bundle service

Split the cloud config bundle loader into focused modules so the crate-level public API remains exports-only while service orchestration, backend transport, metrics, validation, and background loader wiring each live in named files.

Rename the startup flow to distinguish cache-backed loading from backend fetches: startup now reads as load_startup_bundle_with_timeout -> load_startup_bundle -> load_valid_cached_bundle or fetch_remote_bundle_and_update_cache_with_retries. The backend path still validates and writes cache entries, while the startup path still prefers valid identity-matched cache contents before making a request.

This is intended as a structural cleanup only; cloud config bundle load, retry, cache, validation, and refresh semantics are unchanged.

head_commit.message:
Refactor cloud config bundle service

Split the cloud config bundle loader into focused modules so the crate-level public API remains exports-only while service orchestration, backend transport, metrics, validation, and background loader wiring each live in named files.

Rename the startup flow to distinguish cache-backed loading from backend fetches: startup now reads as load_startup_bundle_with_timeout -> load_startup_bundle -> load_valid_cached_bundle or fetch_remote_bundle_and_update_cache_with_retries. The backend path still validates and writes cache entries, while the startup path still prefers valid identity-matched cache contents before making a request.

This is intended as a structural cleanup only; cloud config bundle load, retry, cache, validation, and refresh semantics are unchanged.

head_commit.message:
Use primary source for composed hook requirements

When managed hooks come from a composed requirements field, map the hook source through the first contributing requirements source instead of treating every composite as cloud requirements.

This keeps hook source attribution coarse but honest: requirements composition preserves source order by priority, while hook discovery still only carries one source for the merged hooks field rather than exact per-hook provenance.

[codex] Avoid forced directory refresh during plugin install auth checks (#25381)

## Summary
- Use normal directory loading for plugin install app metadata so
install avoids forced directory refresh while still loading metadata on
cold cache.
- Continue force-refreshing codex_apps tools for auth state.
- Add regression coverage that pre-warms the directory cache and asserts
install returns cached app metadata without extra directory requests.

## Validation
- just fmt
- git diff --check
- just test -p codex-app-server plugin_install_returns_apps_needing_auth
plugin_install_filters_disallowed_apps_needing_auth (blocked locally:
cargo-nextest is not installed)

install avoids forced directory refresh while still loading metadata on
cold cache.
- Continue force-refreshing codex_apps tools for auth state.
- Add regression coverage that pre-warms the directory cache and asserts
install returns cached app metadata without extra directory requests.
